notes: summer_door_sticker: removed 'eye level on the handle side'. That positional detail is not reliably judged from a photo; the brief was amended to match.
clean_door_glass: added that reflections and glare are not dirt.
After GPT-6.2 Sol data review: bottom_cola_bottles: checks the bottle format, not '500 ml', which a photo cannot read.
After GPT-6.2 Sol data review: forward_facing: a can hidden behind the sticker is not misorientation.
After GPT-6.2 Sol data review: top_promo_label, summer_door_sticker: also accept the full cooler photo, since the close-up is optional.

checks.requirement: The top shelf contains Fizzwell Zero cans (black).
checks.question: Check which product occupies the top shelf.
checks.compliant: Fizzwell Zero cans (black) occupy the top shelf.
checks.not_compliant: The top shelf contains a different product or is missing Fizzwell Zero cans.

checks.requirement: The second shelf contains Fizzwell Cola cans (red).
checks.question: Check which product occupies the second shelf.
checks.compliant: Fizzwell Cola cans (red) occupy the second shelf.
checks.not_compliant: The second shelf contains a different product or is missing Fizzwell Cola cans.

checks.requirement: The third shelf contains Fizzwell Orange cans (orange).
checks.question: Check which product occupies the third shelf.
checks.compliant: Fizzwell Orange cans (orange) occupy the third shelf.
checks.not_compliant: The third shelf contains a different product or is missing Fizzwell Orange cans.

checks.requirement: Fizzwell Cola bottles occupy the bottom shelf.
checks.question: Check which product occupies the bottom shelf.
checks.compliant: Fizzwell Cola bottles occupy the bottom shelf.
checks.not_compliant: The bottom shelf contains a different product or is missing Fizzwell Cola bottles.

checks.requirement: The cooler contains only the four specified campaign products, with no other brands' products.
checks.question: Look throughout the cooler for other brands' products or Fizzwell products outside this campaign's range.
checks.compliant: Only the four specified Fizzwell products are present; no other brand's product is in the cooler.
checks.not_compliant: Any other brand's product or any Fizzwell product outside the specified range is in the cooler.

checks.requirement: Every shelf has a full-width front row without gaps.
checks.question: Check every shelf for missing products in its front row.
checks.compliant: The front row fills the width of every shelf, with no shelf surface or cooler back visible through a gap.
checks.not_compliant: A missing front-row product leaves a visible gap on any shelf.

checks.requirement: Products face forward with their brand names readable through the door.
checks.question: Check whether products across the shelves face forward and show the Fizzwell brand name. A can partly hidden behind the door sticker is not turned away.
checks.compliant: Products face forward with the Fizzwell brand name visible.
checks.not_compliant: One or more products are turned so the Fizzwell brand name does not face shoppers.

checks.requirement: Products are upright and presentable, with none visibly fallen or damaged.
checks.question: Look across the cooler for fallen or visibly damaged products.
checks.compliant: Products are upright, with no visibly fallen or damaged cans or bottles.
checks.not_compliant: A product has fallen over or is visibly damaged.

checks.requirement: The interior lights and illuminated FIZZWELL header are on.
checks.question: Check the cooler's interior lights and FIZZWELL header illumination.
checks.compliant: The interior lights and FIZZWELL header are illuminated.
checks.not_compliant: The interior lights or the illuminated FIZZWELL header are off.

checks.question: Look for visible dirt, smears or residue on the door glass. Reflections and light glare on the glass are not dirt.
checks.compliant: The door glass has no visible dirt, smears or residue.
checks.not_compliant: Visible dirt, smears or residue are on the door glass.

checks.requirement: One round black-and-yellow ZERO SUGAR SUMMER sticker is on the door glass.
checks.question: Check the door sticker's number, appearance and wording.
checks.compliant: Exactly one round black-and-yellow sticker reading ZERO SUGAR SUMMER is on the door glass.
checks.not_compliant: The sticker is missing, duplicated, or has different artwork or wording.

checks.requirement: The top shelf has a yellow promotional price label reading 2 for £2 on its front edge.
checks.question: Read the top shelf's front-edge price label and check its colour.
checks.compliant: A yellow front-edge promotional label reads 2 for £2.
checks.not_compliant: The label is missing, is not yellow, is not on the shelf's front edge, or gives different offer wording.

checks.requirement: The second shelf has a white £1.20 price label on its front edge.
checks.question: Check the second shelf's front-edge price label for its colour and price.
checks.not_compliant: The label is missing, is not white, is not on the shelf's front edge, or shows a price other than £1.20.

checks.requirement: The third shelf has a white £1.20 price label on its front edge.
checks.question: Check the third shelf's front-edge price label for its colour and price.
checks.not_compliant: The label is missing, is not white, is not on the shelf's front edge, or shows a price other than £1.20.

checks.requirement: The bottom shelf has a white £1.80 price label on its front edge.
checks.question: Check the bottom shelf's front-edge price label for its colour and price.
checks.not_compliant: The label is missing, is not white, is not on the shelf's front edge, or shows a price other than £1.80.

checks.requirement: No earlier-campaign stickers, shelf labels or other campaign material remain on the cooler.
checks.question: Look across the door and shelves for campaign material other than the specified Zero Sugar Summer sticker and current price labels.
checks.compliant: Only the specified door sticker and current shelf labels are displayed.
checks.not_compliant: An earlier-campaign sticker or label, or other non-current campaign material, remains displayed.

not_checkable.requirement: Keep the lights and header on whenever the store is open, beyond the photographed moment.
Remove earlier-campaign material on the day that campaign ends.
The field rep takes the required full-cooler photograph on each visit.
Increase Fizzwell Zero's share of cold drinks and achieve the target of 25% more Zero cans sold.
Pay stores £20 for each compliant audit.
Restock the cooler before the lunchtime peak every day.
Head office reviews sell-out data weekly.
Cornerstop sets its selling prices and Fizzwell funds the agreed promotion.
